name: large tumor suppressor kinase 1
pathways: negative regulation of cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity

function.text: LATS1 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase LATS1. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine kinase activity and protein serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in negative regulation of cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity and hippo signaling.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Basal Cell Carcinoma; Cervical Adenocarcinoma; Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
